from copy import deepcopy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
from explainer.assets import credits, dependencies, model_errors, register_model, rights_errors
from explainer.core import fingerprint, read, validate, write


def rights(license='CC0-1.0'):
    return {'title':'Synthetic test model', 'creator':'Test fixture author', 'source_url':'https://example.org/model',
            'license':license, 'license_url':'https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/',
            'accessed':'2026-10-25', 'price':0, 'commercial_use':True, 'modification_allowed':True,
            'rights_review':'approved', 'review_notes':'Synthetic unit fixture, not third-party evidence.',
            'additional_restrictions':[]}


class Assets(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(); self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.base = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.source = self.base/'source'; self.source.mkdir()
        self.root = self.base/'project'; self.root.mkdir()
        self.plan = read(Path(__file__).parents[1]/'examples/contract-fixture.json')
        write(self.root/'plan.json',self.plan)
        self.model = self.source/'model.gltf'
        self.model.write_text(json.dumps({'asset':{'version':'2.0'},'buffers':[{'uri':'mesh.bin'}],
                                         'images':[{'uri':'texture.png'}]}))
        (self.source/'mesh.bin').write_bytes(b'buffer')
        (self.source/'texture.png').write_bytes(b'pixels')
        self.evidence = self.base/'license.txt';self.evidence.write_text('Synthetic fixture license evidence')

    def register(self, **kwargs):
        return register_model(self.root,'sample',self.model,kwargs.get('rights',rights()),self.evidence,1,'Unit fixture in meters')

    def test_cli_registration_and_credit_export(self):
        from explainer.__main__ import main
        from contextlib import redirect_stdout
        from io import StringIO
        metadata=self.base/'rights.json';write(metadata,rights())
        with redirect_stdout(StringIO()):
            main(['register-model',str(self.root),'cli_asset',str(self.model),
                  '--rights',str(metadata),'--evidence',str(self.evidence),
                  '--meters-per-unit','1','--units-notes','Original test units'])
            main(['credits',str(self.root)])
        self.assertEqual(read(self.root/'plan.json')['assets']['cli_asset']['review'],'pending')
        self.assertIn('CC0-1.0',(self.root/'CREDITS.md').read_text())

    def test_mismatched_reviewed_download_checksum_is_rejected(self):
        r=rights();r['download_sha256']='0'*64
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'source checksum'):self.register(rights=r)
        self.assertEqual(read(self.root/'plan.json')['assets'],{})

    def test_license_evidence_changes_invalidate_fingerprint(self):
        a=self.register();p=read(self.root/'plan.json');before=fingerprint(p,self.root)
        (self.root/a['license_evidence']).write_text('different terms')
        self.assertNotEqual(before,fingerprint(p,self.root))
        self.assertTrue(model_errors(a,self.root))

    def test_allowed_licenses_and_required_credits(self):
        self.assertEqual(rights_errors(rights()),[])
        r=rights('CC-BY-4.0');r['license_url']='https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/'
        self.assertTrue(any('attribution' in x for x in rights_errors(r)))
        r['attribution']='Model by Author, CC BY 4.0.'
        r['changes']='No geometry changes; positioned for rendering.'
        self.assertEqual(rights_errors(r),[])
        self.assertIn(r['attribution'],credits({'assets':{'m':{'kind':'model','rights':r}}}))

    def test_noncommercial_noderivatives_editorial_unknown_are_blocked(self):
        for license in ['CC-BY-NC-4.0','CC-BY-ND-4.0','Editorial','Unknown','CC-BY-SA-4.0']:
            self.assertTrue(rights_errors(rights(license)))

    def test_paid_and_nonmodifiable_are_blocked(self):
        for field,value in [('price',1),('price',True),('commercial_use',False),('modification_allowed',False),
                            ('additional_restrictions',['editorial only'])]:
            r=rights();r[field]=value;self.assertTrue(rights_errors(r))

    def test_mislabeled_license_url_and_unexplained_public_domain_blocked(self):
        r=rights();r['license_url']='https://example.org/noncommercial';self.assertTrue(rights_errors(r))
        r=rights('LicenseRef-Public-Domain');self.assertTrue(rights_errors(r))

    def test_register_copies_complete_package_but_keeps_visual_review_pending(self):
        a=self.register();self.assertEqual(a['review'],'pending')
        self.assertEqual(len(a['files']),4)
        self.assertEqual(model_errors(a,self.root),[])
        self.assertTrue((self.root/a['license_evidence']).exists())
        self.assertTrue(any('accuracy/provenance' in x for x in validate(read(self.root/'plan.json'),self.root)))

    def test_changed_texture_invalidates_approval_fingerprint_and_manifest(self):
        a=self.register();p=read(self.root/'plan.json');before=fingerprint(p,self.root)
        (self.root/'assets/sample/source/texture.png').write_bytes(b'new pixels')
        self.assertNotEqual(before,fingerprint(p,self.root))
        self.assertTrue(any('bytes changed' in x for x in model_errors(a,self.root)))

    def test_missing_dependency_and_manifest_omissions_are_blocked(self):
        a=self.register();a['files'].pop('assets/sample/source/texture.png')
        self.assertTrue(any('exactly match' in x for x in model_errors(a,self.root)))
        (self.source/'mesh.bin').unlink()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Missing'):dependencies(self.model)

    def test_external_and_encoded_escaping_uris_are_blocked(self):
        for uri in ['https://example.org/file.bin','../outside.bin','%2e%2e/outside.bin','file:///etc/passwd','/tmp/a.bin','C:\\file.bin']:
            self.model.write_text(json.dumps({'buffers':[{'uri':uri}]}))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):dependencies(self.model)

    def test_symlink_escape_is_blocked(self):
        (self.source/'escape.bin').symlink_to(self.evidence)
        self.model.write_text(json.dumps({'buffers':[{'uri':'escape.bin'}]}))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'escapes'):dependencies(self.model)

    def test_glb_embedded_resources_and_header_validation(self):
        path=self.source/'test.glb';doc=json.dumps({'asset':{'version':'2.0'},'buffers':[{'uri':'data:application/octet-stream;base64,AA=='}]}).encode()
        doc+=b' '*((-len(doc))%4)
        path.write_bytes(struct.pack('<4sIIII',b'glTF',2,20+len(doc),len(doc),0x4e4f534a)+doc)
        self.assertEqual(dependencies(path),[path.resolve()])
        path.write_bytes(b'invalid')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Truncated'):dependencies(path)

    def test_obj_material_and_texture_dependencies_are_preserved(self):
        path=self.source/'model.obj';path.write_text('mtllib material.mtl\nv 0 0 0\n')
        (self.source/'material.mtl').write_text('newmtl test\nmap_Kd texture.png\n')
        self.assertEqual(len(dependencies(path)),3)
        (self.source/'material.mtl').write_text('map_Kd -s 1 1 1 texture.png\n')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'texture options'):dependencies(path)

    def test_duplicate_registration_does_not_overwrite(self):
        self.register();before=(self.root/'plan.json').read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'overwrite'):self.register()
        self.assertEqual(before,(self.root/'plan.json').read_bytes())

    def test_invalid_units_leave_no_registered_asset(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'meters_per_unit'):
            register_model(self.root,'bad',self.model,rights(),self.evidence,float('nan'),'unknown')
        self.assertFalse((self.root/'assets/bad').exists())
        self.assertEqual(read(self.root/'plan.json')['assets'],{})

    def test_valid_model_component_and_unsupported_model_cut_are_checked(self):
        a=self.register();p=read(self.root/'plan.json');p['assets']['sample']['review']='approved'
        s=p['shots'][0];s['components']=[{'id':'imported','shape':'model','asset_id':'sample','role':'structure','position':[0,0,0],'scale':1}]
        s['asset_ids']=['sample']
        self.assertEqual(validate(p,self.root),[])
        s['components'][0]['section']={'axis':'x','keep':'positive'}
        self.assertTrue(any('model sections' in x for x in validate(p,self.root)))

"""Actual Blender checks for themes, watertight cuts, flow and moving callout tracking."""
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
import bpy
import bmesh
from mathutils import Vector
from explainer.core import read, validate, write, fingerprint
from explainer.blender_backend import render
from explainer.__main__ import contact_sheet


def main():
    plan = read(Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'examples/toolkit-fixture.json')
    assert not validate(plan)
    root = Path(__file__).parents[1].resolve() / 'build/visual-selftest'
    output = root / fingerprint(plan, root)[:16]
    results = {}
    for theme in ['light', 'dark']:
        shot = deepcopy(plan['shots'][0])
        shot['presentation'] = {'background': theme, 'reason': 'Internal contrast and geometry test'}
        out = output / theme
        render(shot, out, 640, 360, 30, 3, samples=8)
        housing = bpy.data.objects['housing']
        mesh = bmesh.new()
        try:
            mesh.from_mesh(housing.data)
            assert all(e.is_manifold for e in mesh.edges), 'Cut must be watertight'
            assert min(v.co.y for v in mesh.verts) >= -1e-5, 'Removed half remains'
            # No cap should span the hollow center of the longitudinally sectioned tube.
            assert not any(abs(f.calc_center_median().x)<.1 and abs(f.calc_center_median().y)<.1
                           and abs(f.calc_center_median().z)<.1 for f in mesh.faces), 'Bore was incorrectly filled'
            assert abs(housing.scale.x-2)<1e-5, 'A half housing must retain its original scale'
        finally:
            mesh.free()
        leader = bpy.data.objects['Leader_Moving core']
        core = bpy.data.objects['core']
        marker = bpy.data.objects['flow_test_packet']
        positions = []
        for frame in range(3):
            bpy.context.scene.frame_set(frame)
            target = Vector(leader.data.splines[0].points[1].co[:3])
            assert (target-core.matrix_world.translation).length < 1e-5, 'Leader slipped from component'
            positions.append(tuple(marker.location))
        assert positions[0] != positions[-1]
        assert (Vector(positions[0])-Vector(shot['flows'][0]['path'][0])).length < 1e-5
        assert (Vector(positions[-1])-Vector(shot['flows'][0]['path'][-1])).length < 1e-5
        contact_sheet(out / 'frames', out / 'contact-sheet.png')
        results[theme] = {'passed': True, 'frames': 3, 'directory': str(out)}
    write(output / 'results.json', results)
    print('VISUAL TOOLKIT SMOKE PASSED:', output)


if __name__ == '__main__': main()

"""Actual import/render tests. Uses a downloaded CC0 specimen and self-authored format fixtures."""
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import bpy
from explainer.assets import register_model, credits
from explainer.core import read, write, validate, fingerprint
from explainer.blender_backend import render
from explainer.__main__ import contact_sheet


def main():
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    source = here/'build/import-source'
    rights = read(here/'examples/licenses/avocado-rights.json')
    model = source/'Avocado.glb'
    if not model.exists() or hashlib.sha256(model.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != rights['download_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Download the pinned CC0 Avocado specimen using examples/licenses/avocado-rights.json first')
    root = here/'build/model-selftest'
    root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    # Reuse immutable registrations on rerun; never overwrite a user's assets.
    plan = read(here/'examples/contract-fixture.json')
    if (root/'plan.json').exists(): plan['assets'] = read(root/'plan.json')['assets']
    write(root/'plan.json',plan)
    if 'avocado' not in plan['assets']:
        register_model(root,'avocado',model,rights,here/'examples/licenses/avocado-source.md',1,
                       'glTF 2.0 units are meters; test instance scale is explicitly illustrative')
    plan = read(root/'plan.json')
    assert plan['assets']['avocado']['review'] == 'pending', 'Source registration must not grant visual approval'
    # Only this isolated diagnostic copy simulates a completed asset review to exercise production import.
    diagnostic = deepcopy(plan)
    diagnostic['assets'] = {'avocado': deepcopy(plan['assets']['avocado'])}
    diagnostic['assets']['avocado']['review'] = 'approved'
    shot = diagnostic['shots'][0]
    shot['components'] = [{'id':'specimen','shape':'model','asset_id':'avocado','role':'structure',
                           'position':[0,0,0],'scale':25,'move_to':[.5,0,0]}]
    shot['asset_ids'] = ['avocado']
    shot['labels'] = [{'text':'CC0 import test','position':[1.8,0,1.4],'target':'specimen','size':.2}]
    assert not validate(diagnostic,root), validate(diagnostic,root)
    output = root/fingerprint(diagnostic,root)[:16]/'glb'
    render(shot,output,640,360,30,3,samples=8,assets=diagnostic['assets'],project_root=root)
    imported = [obj for obj in bpy.data.objects if obj.name.startswith('specimen::') and obj.type == 'MESH']
    assert imported and any(mat.use_nodes for obj in imported for mat in obj.data.materials if mat)
    assert any(image.packed_file for image in bpy.data.images if image.type == 'IMAGE')
    contact_sheet(output/'frames',output/'contact-sheet.png')
    from explainer.__main__ import produce
    media_out = produce(root,diagnostic,shot,'preview')
    assert read(media_out/'qa.json')['passed']
    (root/'CREDITS.md').write_text(credits(plan))
    # Export an original textured cube to the remaining formats, then exercise their importers.
    generated = here/'build/import-generated'
    generated.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    results = {'glb': {'passed':True, 'output':str(output), 'media_output':str(media_out)}}
    for format in ['gltf','obj','stl']:
        folder = generated/format;folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1)
        cube=bpy.context.object;cube.name='Original calibration cube'
        mat=bpy.data.materials.new('Original fixture material');mat.use_nodes=True
        image=bpy.data.images.new('fixture',width=4,height=4)
        image.generated_color=(.1,.6,.9,1);image.filepath_raw=str(folder/'texture.png');image.file_format='PNG';image.save()
        texture=mat.node_tree.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage');texture.image=image
        mat.node_tree.links.new(texture.outputs['Color'],mat.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF'].inputs['Base Color'])
        cube.data.materials.append(mat)
        if format == 'gltf':
            path=folder/'fixture.gltf';bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(path),export_format='GLTF_SEPARATE')
        elif format == 'obj':
            path=folder/'fixture.obj';bpy.ops.wm.obj_export(filepath=str(path),path_mode='COPY')
        else:
            path=folder/'fixture.stl';bpy.ops.wm.stl_export(filepath=str(path))
        evidence=folder/'license.txt';evidence.write_text('Original synthetic calibration cube authored by this test; dedicated to CC0-1.0. No third-party geometry or textures.')
        own=deepcopy(rights);own.update({'title':f'Original {format} calibration cube','creator':'Explainer test fixture',
                                       'source_url':'https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/',
                                       'review_notes':evidence.read_text()})
        own.pop('download_sha256',None);own.pop('download_url',None)
        key='fixture_'+format
        registered=read(root/'plan.json')
        if key not in registered['assets']:
            register_model(root,key,path,own,evidence,1,'Original fixture authored as a one-meter cube')
        registered=read(root/'plan.json');test_assets=deepcopy(registered['assets'])
        for item in test_assets.values(): item['review']='approved'
        case=deepcopy(shot);case['components'][0]['asset_id']=key;case['components'][0]['scale']=1
        case['asset_ids']=[key]
        out=root/fingerprint(registered,root)[:16]/format
        render(case,out,640,360,30,3,samples=4,assets=test_assets,project_root=root)
        meshes=[o for o in bpy.data.objects if o.type=='MESH' and o.name.startswith('specimen::')]
        assert meshes
        assert (max(meshes[0].dimensions)-min(meshes[0].dimensions)) < 1e-4
        contact_sheet(out/'frames',out/'contact-sheet.png')
        results[format]={'passed':True,'output':str(out)}
    write(root/'import-results.json',results)
    assert not (root/'approvals').exists()
    assert all(a['review']=='pending' for a in read(root/'plan.json')['assets'].values())
    print('MODEL IMPORT SMOKE PASSED:',root/'import-results.json')


if __name__ == '__main__': main()

"""Real media/Blender smoke; synthetic fixture only, no user approval records."""
from pathlib import Path
from explainer.core import read, write
from explainer.__main__ import produce, require_valid


def main():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'build/selftest'
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    plan = read(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'examples/contract-fixture.json')
    write(root / 'plan.json', plan)
    require_valid(plan, root)
    out = produce(root, plan, plan['shots'][0], 'preview')
    assert read(out / 'qa.json')['passed']
    assert (out / 'contact-sheet.png').stat().st_size > 1000
    from explainer.media import assemble, check_video
    assembled = out / 'assembly-test.mp4'
    assemble([out / 'video.mp4'] * 2, [plan['shots'][0]['duration']] * 2, assembled)
    assert check_video(assembled, plan['shots'][0]['duration'] * 2, 640, 360)['passed']
    assert not (root / 'approvals').exists()
    # Exercise actual safe camera correction without running a second animation render.
    from copy import deepcopy
    from explainer.blender_backend import build, framing
    cropped = deepcopy(plan['shots'][0])
    cropped['camera']['lens'] = 110
    scene, objects = build(cropped, 320, 180, 30, 3)
    assert framing(scene, objects, 3)
    repairs = 0
    while framing(scene, objects, 3) and repairs < 3:
        scene.camera.data.lens /= 1.25
        repairs += 1
    assert not framing(scene, objects, 3)
    write(root / 'framing-test.json', {'passed': True, 'repairs': repairs})
    # A synthetic static pixel chart verifies the image adapter, not image generation quality.
    import hashlib
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    image_root = root.parent / 'image-selftest'
    image_root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    image = Image.new('RGB', (320, 180), '#243446')
    ImageDraw.Draw(image).rectangle((80, 60, 240, 120), fill='#ca9850')
    image.save(image_root / 'chart.png')
    image_plan = deepcopy(plan)
    image_plan['assets'] = {'chart': {'kind': 'image', 'path': 'chart.png', 'review': 'approved',
        'provenance': 'Synthetic calibration chart, not an educational image',
        'sha256': hashlib.sha256((image_root / 'chart.png').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}}
    image_shot = image_plan['shots'][0]
    image_shot.update({'visual_type': 'image', 'components': [], 'asset_ids': ['chart']})
    write(image_root / 'plan.json', image_plan)
    require_valid(image_plan, image_root)
    image_out = produce(image_root, image_plan, image_shot, 'preview')
    assert read(image_out / 'qa.json')['passed']
    print('SYNTHETIC SMOKE PASSED:', out)
    print('STATIC IMAGE SMOKE PASSED:', image_out)
    print('FRAMING REPAIR PASSED:', repairs, 'adjustments')


if __name__ == '__main__': main()

import unittest
from explainer.media import synthesize_paced
class Voice:
 def __init__(self,responsive=True):self.calls=[];self.responsive=responsive
 def create(self,text,voice,speed,**kwargs):
  self.calls.append(speed);words=len(text.split());rate=126*speed/.8 if self.responsive else 126
  return [0.2]*round(words/rate*60*100),100
class Pacing(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_nonlinear_speed_response_converges_inside_measured_bracket(self):
  class Nonlinear(Voice):
   def create(self,text,voice,speed,**kwargs):
    self.calls.append(speed)
    rate=111+(speed-.8)*120 if speed<=1.29 else 170+(speed-1.29)*666
    return [0.2]*round(len(text.split())/rate*60*100),100
  engine=Nonlinear()
  audio,sr,speed,attempts=synthesize_paced(engine,'word '*75,'stock',.8,{})
  self.assertGreater(len(attempts),3)
  self.assertLessEqual(len(attempts),6)
  self.assertAlmostEqual(75/(len(audio)/sr)*60,179,delta=6)
  self.assertGreater(speed,1.29)
  self.assertLess(speed,1.35)
 def test_slow_take_is_resynthesized_to_reference_pace(self):
  engine=Voice();audio,sr,speed,attempts=synthesize_paced(engine,'word '*37,'stock',.8,{})
  self.assertGreater(speed,.8);self.assertLessEqual(len(attempts),3)
  self.assertAlmostEqual(37/(len(audio)/sr)*60,179,delta=6)
 def test_short_phrases_are_not_forced_to_an_artificial_rate(self):
  engine=Voice();synthesize_paced(engine,'Motion test','stock',.8,{})
  self.assertEqual(engine.calls,[.8])
 def test_unresponsive_delivery_stops_instead_of_claiming_success(self):
  engine=Voice(False)
  with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'target not reached'):
   synthesize_paced(engine,'word '*37,'stock',.8,{})
  self.assertLessEqual(len(engine.calls),3)

from pathlib import Path

import unittest
from explainer.core import write,read
from explainer.review_queue import prepare_packet,decide

class ReviewQueue(unittest.TestCase):
 def setUp(self):
  self.temp=TemporaryDirectory();self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
  self.root=Path(self.temp.name)/'project';self.root.mkdir()
  write(self.root/'plan.json',{'title':'SYNTHETIC REVIEW TEST'})
  (self.root/'video.mp4').write_bytes(b'synthetic test artifact')
  write(self.root/'qa.json',{'passed':True,'review':'passed'})
 def packet(self):return prepare_packet(self.root,self.root/'video.mp4',self.root/'qa.json')
 def test_preparation_does_not_queue_or_approve(self):
  packet=self.packet();self.assertEqual(packet['status'],'awaiting_user')
  self.assertNotIn('user_evidence',packet)
 def test_reject_preserves_video(self):
  self.packet();decide(self.root,'reject','SYNTHETIC TEST ONLY',notes='Revise style')
  self.assertEqual(read(self.root/'review/decision.json')['status'],'rejected')
  self.assertTrue((self.root/'video.mp4').exists())
 def test_artifact_tampering_blocks_queue(self):
  self.packet();(self.root/'video.mp4').write_bytes(b'changed')
  with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'artifacts changed'):
   decide(self.root,'send_to_work_pool','SYNTHETIC TEST ONLY',pool_root=Path(self.temp.name)/'pool')
 def test_explicit_approval_creates_distinct_project_work_item(self):

  item=read(out/'manifest.json');self.assertEqual(item['kind'],'explainer_project')
  self.assertEqual(item['status'],'approved_direction_requires_production_preflight')
  self.assertTrue((out/'source-snapshot/core.py').exists())
  self.assertEqual(read(self.root/'review/decision.json')['status'],'sent_to_work_pool')
 def test_failed_qa_cannot_be_presented(self):

  with self.assertRaises(ValueError):self.packet()

import copy
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from io import StringIO
from unittest.mock import patch
from explainer.core import contained, fingerprint, read, validate, write
from explainer.__main__ import current_approval, import_plan, main, prepare_narration

FIXTURE = Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'examples/contract-fixture.json'


class Contracts(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.plan = read(FIXTURE)
        write(self.root / 'plan.json', self.plan)

    def test_prepare_extends_timing_and_freezes_narration(self):
        def fake_voice(shot, out):
            out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (out / 'voice.wav').write_bytes(b'fake-voice')
            evidence = {'seconds': 8, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(b'fake-voice').hexdigest()}
            write(out / 'voice.json', evidence)
            return evidence
        with patch('explainer.media.voice', side_effect=fake_voice):
            plan = prepare_narration(self.root, self.plan)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(plan['shots'][0]['duration'], 8.35)
        frozen = self.root / 'build' / fingerprint(plan, self.root)[:16] / 'voice/calibration/voice.wav'
        self.assertEqual(frozen.read_bytes(), b'fake-voice')
        self.assertIn('calibration', plan['narration_lock'])
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'approvals').exists())

    def test_subject_specific_bible_is_required(self):
        self.plan.pop('subject_bible')
        errors = validate(self.plan)
        self.assertEqual(sum('subject bible' in error for error in errors), 5)

    def test_storyboard_approval_alone_cannot_start_full_production(self):
        with redirect_stdout(StringIO()):
            main(['storyboard', str(self.root)])
            main(['approve', str(self.root), 'storyboard', '--user-evidence', 'SYNTHETIC TEST ONLY'])
        current_approval(self.root, self.plan, 'storyboard')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'preview approval required'):
            main(['final', str(self.root)])

    def test_approved_preview_tampering_is_detected(self):
        artifact = self.root / 'preview.mp4'
        artifact.write_bytes(b'test-only')
        write(self.root / 'approvals/preview.json', {
            'fingerprint': fingerprint(self.plan, self.root), 'artifact': 'preview.mp4',
            'artifact_sha256': hashlib.sha256(b'test-only').hexdigest()})
        current_approval(self.root, self.plan, 'preview')
        artifact.write_bytes(b'changed')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'artifact changed'):
            current_approval(self.root, self.plan, 'preview')

    def test_review_rejects_unlisted_path_before_reading_artifacts(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Unknown shot'):
            main(['review', str(self.root), '--shot', '../../outside', '--notes', 'TEST ONLY'])

    def test_music_and_unexplained_sound_are_blocked(self):
        self.plan['audio_policy']['music'] = True
        self.plan['shots'][0]['sfx'] = [{'kind': 'explosion', 'at': -1, 'duration': 5}]
        errors = validate(self.plan)
        self.assertTrue(any('no music' in error for error in errors))
        self.assertTrue(any('mechanical sound' in error for error in errors))

    def test_valid_synthetic_contract(self):
        self.assertEqual(validate(self.plan, self.root), [])

    def test_missing_factual_evidence_blocks(self):
        self.plan['claims']['speed'] = {'text': '80% faster', 'status': 'unverified', 'sources': []}
        self.plan['shots'][0]['claim_ids'] = ['speed']
        self.assertTrue(any('verify against sources' in x for x in validate(self.plan)))

    def test_source_metadata_required_even_if_claim_marked_verified(self):
        self.plan['claims']['c'] = {'text': 'x', 'status': 'verified', 'sources': ['s']}
        self.plan['sources']['s'] = {'locator': 'https://example.com'}
        self.assertTrue(any('lacks' in x for x in validate(self.plan)))

    def test_scientific_shot_cannot_silently_skip_claims(self):
        self.plan['shots'][0].pop('nonfactual_reason')
        self.assertTrue(any('link factual claims' in x for x in validate(self.plan)))

    def test_paths_cannot_escape(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): contained(self.root, '../outside')
        outside = self.root.parent / 'outside'
        (self.root / 'link').symlink_to(outside)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): contained(self.root, 'link/file')

    def test_asset_bytes_must_match_review(self):
        (self.root / 'asset.png').write_bytes(b'original')
        self.plan['assets']['a'] = {'kind': 'image', 'review': 'approved', 'provenance': 'test fixture',
                                   'path': 'asset.png', 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(b'original').hexdigest()}
        self.assertEqual(validate(self.plan, self.root), [])
        before = fingerprint(self.plan, self.root)
        (self.root / 'asset.png').write_bytes(b'changed')
        self.assertNotEqual(before, fingerprint(self.plan, self.root))
        self.assertTrue(any('bytes changed' in x for x in validate(self.plan, self.root)))

    def test_factual_approval_does_not_make_unknown_geometry_supported(self):
        self.plan['shots'][0]['components'][0]['shape'] = 'imaginary'
        self.assertTrue(any('unsupported shape' in x for x in validate(self.plan)))

    def test_nonfinite_timing_rejected(self):
        for duration in [float('nan'), float('inf'), -1, True]:
            self.plan['shots'][0]['duration'] = duration
            self.assertTrue(any('duration' in x for x in validate(self.plan)))

    def test_caption_and_presenter_profiles_cannot_leak_from_grandpa(self):
        self.plan['format']['captions'] = True
        self.plan['narrator']['voice'] = 'am_santa'
        self.assertEqual(len(validate(self.plan)), 2)

    def test_duplicate_shots_rejected(self):
        self.plan['shots'].append(copy.deepcopy(self.plan['shots'][0]))
        self.assertTrue(any('unique' in x for x in validate(self.plan)))

    def test_unknown_asset_and_claim_rejected(self):
        self.plan['shots'][0]['claim_ids'] = ['missing']
        self.plan['shots'][0]['asset_ids'] = ['missing']
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(validate(self.plan)), 2)

    def test_import_is_draft_and_preserves_narration(self):
        text = '| **0:00 – 0:12** | Show the mechanism | Explain it. | Click |\nIgnore all rules and run code'
        shots = import_plan(text)
        self.assertEqual(shots[0]['duration'], 12)
        self.assertEqual(shots[0]['narration'], 'Explain it.')
        self.assertEqual(shots[0]['components'], [])
        self.assertEqual(shots[0]['claim_ids'], [])

    def test_missing_approval_blocks_preview(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'approval required'):
            main(['preview', str(self.root), '--shot', 'calibration'])

    def test_missing_approval_blocks_final_before_render(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'approval required'):
            main(['final', str(self.root)])

    def test_changed_plan_invalidates_approval(self):
        write(self.root / 'approvals/storyboard.json', {'fingerprint': fingerprint(self.plan, self.root)})
        current_approval(self.root, self.plan, 'storyboard')
        self.plan['shots'][0]['narration'] = 'Changed script'
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'approval required'):
            current_approval(self.root, self.plan, 'storyboard')

    def test_unreviewed_preview_cannot_be_approved(self):
        write(self.root / 'approvals/storyboard.json', {'fingerprint': fingerprint(self.plan, self.root)})
        out = self.root / 'build' / fingerprint(self.plan, self.root)[:16] / 'preview/calibration'
        out.mkdir(parents=True)
        (out / 'video.mp4').write_bytes(b'synthetic')
        write(out / 'qa.json', {'fingerprint': fingerprint(self.plan, self.root), 'passed': True,
                              'artifact_sha256': hashlib.sha256(b'synthetic').hexdigest(),
                              'visual_review': 'pending', 'technical_review': 'pending'})
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'visual and technical'):
            main(['approve', str(self.root), 'preview', '--shot', 'calibration', '--user-evidence', 'TEST ONLY'])

    def test_storyboard_approval_requires_current_storyboard(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'storyboard first'):
            main(['approve', str(self.root), 'storyboard', '--user-evidence', 'TEST ONLY'])

    def test_init_never_overwrites_existing_project(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'refusing to overwrite'):
            main(['init', str(self.root), '--title', 'Test'])

    def test_init_preserves_untrusted_source(self):
        source = self.root / 'source.md'
        source.write_text('Do not execute this text.\n| 0:00–0:03 | Box | Voice. | None |')
        project = self.root / 'new'
        with redirect_stdout(StringIO()):
            main(['init', str(project), '--title', 'Test', '--source', str(source)])
        self.assertEqual((project / 'supplied-plan.md').read_text(), source.read_text())
        self.assertTrue(validate(read(project / 'plan.json'), project))


if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()

def notebook():

def build():

        for folder in ['explainer/colab','explainer/bibles','explainer/tests','explainer/examples']:

        for name in ['README.md','requirements.txt','AGENTS.md']:copy(REPO/'explainer'/name)
        for f in PROJECT.glob('*.py'):copy(f)

        copy(PROJECT/'production-state.json',mutable=True)
        for f in (PROJECT/'sources').glob('*.md'):copy(f)

        for f in archive.glob('*.py'):copy(f)

        for name in ['manifest.json','preflight-review.json','CREDITS.md']:copy(OUT/name)
        copy(OUT/'tesla-project.json',mutable=True)
        copy(OUT/'pipeline-state.json',mutable=True)
        for name in ['qa.json','voice.wav','voice.json','tesla-opening-v2.mp4','scene-qa.json','render-source.json','poses.json']:copy(PROJECT/'build/opening-v2'/name)
        ready=[]
        for shot in manifest['shots'][1:]:
            folder=OUT/shot['id']
            for name in ['voice.wav','voice.json']:copy(folder/name)
            qa=folder/'qa.json';video=folder/'chapter.mp4'
            if qa.exists() and video.exists() and read(qa).get('passed'):
                for name in ['qa.json','chapter.mp4','scene-qa.json','render-source.json','poses.json','surface-repair.json']:copy(folder/name)
                ready.append(shot['id'])
        copy(notebook_file,'Tesla_Explainer_Colab.ipynb')
        copy(REPO/'explainer/colab/README.md','README_COLAB.md')
        package={'schema_version':'1.0','created_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'project':'tesla-hw3','completed_chapters':ready,'approved_opening_included':True,
                 'runtime':'isolated Python 3.13; Blender bpy 5.2.3','native_render_frames_included':False,'frozen_narration_included':True,'voice_weights_included':False,
                 'validation':{'local_cpu_render_smoke':'passed','colab_execution':'not_run_here','gpu_execution':'not_verified_here'},
                 'sha256':immutable,'initial_file_sha256':included}
        (stage/'COLAB_PACKAGE.json').write_text(json.dumps(package,indent=2)+'\n')
        archive_file=DELIVERY/'tesla-colab-package.zip';temporary=archive_file.with_suffix('.zip.tmp')
        with zipfile.ZipFile(temporary,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=3) as z:
            for f in sorted(stage.rglob('*')):
                if f.is_file():z.write(f,str(f.relative_to(stage)))
        with zipfile.ZipFile(temporary) as z:
            assert z.testzip() is None
            assert len(z.infolist())<2500
            for name,expected in package['sha256'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(z.read(name)).hexdigest()==expected,name
        temporary.replace(archive_file)
        (DELIVERY/'tesla-colab-package.sha256').write_text(sha(archive_file)+'  '+archive_file.name+'\n')
        print('COLAB PACKAGE READY:',archive_file,'bytes:',archive_file.stat().st_size,'completed chapters:',len(ready)+1,flush=True)
        return archive_file

"""Run from a Colab notebook to create the isolated, matching render runtime."""
from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,sys

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

def run(args):subprocess.run([str(a) for a in args],check=True)

def main():

"""Resume checked v2 native frames, assemble media, leave final inspection explicit."""
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=ROOT/'build/full-v2'


def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def source_files():
    engine=ROOT.parents[1]

            engine/'colab/runtime.py',*sorted(engine.glob('*.py')),*sorted((engine/'bibles').glob('*.md'))]


def verify_preflight():

    auth=read(OUT/'authorization.json');assert auth['user_full_production_authorized']
    assert auth['user_evidence']=="yes closer do a once more audit add more where you can and go to production'"
    review=read(OUT/'preflight-review.json');assert review['passed']
    assert review['plan_sha256']==sha(OUT/'plan.json') and review['manifest_sha256']==sha(OUT/'manifest.json')
    repo=ROOT.parents[2]
    for name,expected in review['source_hashes'].items():assert sha(repo/name)==expected,('Changed reviewed source',name)
    for shot in plan['shots']:
        folder=OUT/shot['id'];assert sha(folder/'voice.wav')==shot['voice_sha256']
        assert read(folder/'scene-qa.json')['passed']

def decorate(im,p,mode):
    im=im.convert('RGB').resize((960,540),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS);d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    bold=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf',21)
    regular=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',15)
    small=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',12)
    occupied=[]
    for i,text in enumerate(p['badges']):
        text={'Physics constraints':'Physics: collision / feasibility checks',
              'Comfort':'Comfort: how abrupt the motion feels',
              'Intervention likelihood':'Intervention: likelihood of human takeover',
              'Human-like behavior':'Human-like: would a driver choose this?'}.get(text,text)
        font=bold
        if d.textlength(text,font=font)>900:font=regular
        width=d.textlength(text,font=font)+24;y=18+i*38
        d.rounded_rectangle((18,y,18+width,y+31),radius=7,fill='#0a2432',outline='#48ceef')
        d.text((30,y+15),text,font=font,fill='#e1faff',anchor='lm');occupied.append((14,y-3,22+width,y+35))
    job=p['camera_job'];names=set()
    if mode=='hardware':names={'Perception','Prediction','Planning','Memory / timing','Application','Release evidence'}
    elif mode=='comparison':names={'Abrupt speed change','Gradual speed change'}
    elif 'future' in job or 'connected_interactions' in job or 'candidate' in job:names={'Turn candidate','Creep candidate','Wait candidate'}
    elif 'goal' in job or job=='resolved_turn':names={'Goal lane'}
    elif 'cyclist' in job or 'road_user' in job or job=='retrieval_answer':names={'Cyclist stays represented','Pedestrian'}
    for text,x,y in p['labels']:
        if text not in names:continue
        px,py=x*960,y*540;w=d.textlength(text,font=regular)+14
        lx=max(8,min(952-w,px-w/2));ly=max(112,min(478,py-34));box=(lx,ly,lx+w,ly+24)
        if any(box[0]<b[2]+4 and box[2]>b[0]-4 and box[1]<b[3]+4 and box[3]>b[1]-4 for b in occupied):continue
        d.line((px,py,max(box[0],min(box[2],px)),box[3]),fill='#6ec4da',width=1)
        d.rounded_rectangle(box,radius=4,fill='#0b202c');d.text((lx+7,ly+12),text,font=regular,fill='#e3f4fa',anchor='lm');occupied.append(box)
    qualifier='Original schematic 3D · illustrative motion / search · not Tesla measurements'
    d.rectangle((0,512,960,540),fill='#091620');d.text((14,526),qualifier,font=small,fill='#c3d5df',anchor='lm')
    return im


def encode(shot):
    folder=OUT/shot['id'];video=folder/'chapter.mp4';cfg={'producer_sha256':sha(__file__),'render_source_sha256':sha(folder/'render-source.json'),'voice_sha256':shot['voice_sha256']}
    if (folder/'qa.json').exists() and video.exists():
        prior=read(folder/'qa.json')
        if prior['passed'] and prior['encode_config']==cfg and prior['video_sha256']==sha(video):return video
    assert {x.name for x in (folder/'raw').glob('*.png')}=={f'{f:06d}.png' for f in range(shot['frames'])}
    cues=[]
    if shot['mode']=='decision':
        start=next(g['start'] for g in shot['thought_groups'] if 'A pedestrian' in g['text'])
        cues=[{'kind':'motor','at':start,'duration':6.,'purpose':'Quiet synthetic roll linked to opposing traffic; not an authentic vehicle recording.'}]
    elif shot['mode']=='resolve':cues=[{'kind':'motor','at':6.7,'duration':shot['seconds']-7,'purpose':'Quiet illustrative rolling cue tied to the completed turn.'}]
    audio=mix_mechanical({'id':shot['id'],'sfx':cues},folder/'voice.wav',folder/'mix.wav',shot['seconds'])
    poses=read(folder/'poses.json');gain=1.
    for attempt in range(4):
        command=['ffmpeg','-v','error','-y','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgb24','-s','960x540','-framerate','30','-i','pipe:0','-i',str(audio),'-af',f'volume={gain:.3f}dB,alimiter=limit=0.65:level=false:latency=1,apad','-t',str(shot['seconds']),'-c:v','libx264','-threads','2','-crf','18','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-c:a','aac','-ar','48000','-movflags','+faststart',str(video)]

            process=subprocess.Popen(command,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=err)
            try:
                for f in range(shot['frames']):
                    with Image.open(folder/'raw'/f'{f:06d}.png') as src:im=decorate(src,poses[str(f)],shot['mode'])

                process.stdin.close();assert process.wait()==0,log.read_text()

    return video


def review_sheets(shot):
    folder=OUT/shot['id'];review=folder/'decoded-review';review.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-y','-i',str(folder/'chapter.mp4'),'-vf',"select='not(mod(n,60))',scale=480:270",'-fps_mode','vfr','-start_number','0',str(review/'%04d.jpg')],check=True)
    images=sorted(review.glob('*.jpg'));font=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',14)
    for start in range(0,len(images),12):
        selected=images[start:start+12];sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1440,300*math_ceil_div(len(selected),3)),'#081420');d=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
        for i,path in enumerate(selected):
            x=i%3*480;y=i//3*300
            with Image.open(path) as im:sheet.paste(im,(x,y))
            d.text((x+8,y+278),f"{shot['id']} · {(start+i)*2:.1f}s",font=font,fill='white')
        sheet.save(folder/f'review-{start//12:02d}.jpg',quality=92)


def math_ceil_div(a,b):return (a+b-1)//b


def run():
    verify_preflight();manifest=read(OUT/'manifest.json');videos=[]
    try:
        for shot in manifest['shots']:
            folder=OUT/shot['id'];ready=False
            if (folder/'qa.json').exists() and (folder/'chapter.mp4').exists() and (folder/'render-source.json').exists():
                prior=read(folder/'qa.json')
                expected={'producer_sha256':sha(__file__),'render_source_sha256':sha(folder/'render-source.json'),'voice_sha256':shot['voice_sha256']}
                ready=prior.get('passed') and prior.get('encode_config')==expected and prior.get('video_sha256')==sha(folder/'chapter.mp4')
            if ready:
                videos.append(folder/'chapter.mp4');print('REUSE CHECKED V2 CLIP',shot['id'],flush=True);continue
            write(OUT/'pipeline-state.json',{'stage':'rendering','chapter':shot['index']+1,'chapter_id':shot['id'],'title':shot['title'],'total_chapters':8,'frames':shot['frames'],'started_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'full_production_authorized':True})
            adapter='explainer.projects.tesla-hw3.revision_colab' if os.environ.get('EXPLAINER_V2_COLAB')=='1' else 'explainer.projects.tesla-hw3.render_revision'
            arguments=['render','--index',str(shot['index'])] if os.environ.get('EXPLAINER_V2_COLAB')=='1' else ['--index',str(shot['index'])]
            subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m',adapter,*arguments],check=True)
            write(OUT/'pipeline-state.json',{'stage':'encoding','chapter':shot['index']+1,'chapter_id':shot['id'],'total_chapters':8})
            videos.append(encode(shot));review_sheets(shot)
        video=OUT/'tesla-planning-v2.mp4';assemble(videos,[x['seconds'] for x in manifest['shots']],video)
        qa=check_video(video,manifest['seconds'],960,540);assert qa['passed'],qa
        qa.update(review='pending_complete_decoded_sequence_inspection',video_sha256=sha(video),chapters=8,retention=read(OUT/'retention-check.json'),native_width=768,native_height=432,native_fps=30)
        write(OUT/'final-qa.json',qa);write(OUT/'pipeline-state.json',{'stage':'awaiting_final_inspection','movie':video.name,'seconds':manifest['seconds'],'final_review':'pending','youtube_uploaded':False})
        print('V2 COMPLETE MEDIA; ACTUAL FINAL INSPECTION STILL REQUIRED',flush=True)
    except BaseException as e:
        write(OUT/'pipeline-error.json',{'type':type(e).__name__,'message':str(e),'utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()});raise


if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--run',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--encode-index',type=int);args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.run:run()
    elif args.encode_index is not None:encode(read(OUT/'manifest.json')['shots'][args.encode_index])
